sentences.text:
Shri Chandra Prakash Purohit - Advocate for the appella
 Shri Rahul Solanki - G.A. for the respondent/State.
Heard on I.A.No.17396/2025, which is an application seeking suspension of sentence on behalf of the appellant.

Appellant has been convicted for the offence under Section 366 and 376(2)(n) of IPC and sentenced to 5 years R.I. with fine of Rs.1,000/-, and 10 years RI with fine of Rs. 5,000/- with usual default stipulation.
Counsel for the appellant submits that the conviction and sentence passed by the trial court against the appellant are bad in law.
He is innocent and he has falsely been implicated in the present case.
He has every hope of success in this appeal.
The final hearing of this appeal will likely to take long time, hence prayed for suspension of sentence and release of the appellant on bail.

Counsel for the appellant has also placed on record the custody report of the present appellant which is reproduced below:-
Description

Year Month day Period under consideration:-10.04.2019 to 02.07.2020 and 01 03 07 02.12.2022 to 14.12.2022 Prior sentence date - - - Present sentence undergone from 14.12.2022 to 02 09 26 10.10.2025 Serving punishment 04 01 03 Prison avoidance 00 11 29
Total punishment served 05 01 02
Counsel for the State has opposed the application.

Considering the above, the application is allowed and it is directed that the execution of remaining jail sentence passed against the appellant shall remain suspended and he be released on bail upon his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 23.06.2026 and on such further dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the Registry during the pendency of this appeal.
It is directed that the appellant shall not contact with the prosecutrix in any way either physically or through any other mode of social media.
If any violation of the condition is found, then this order shall be recalled.
